comment: The text allows countries to proceed without national trust infrastructure while acknowledging the risks, but it does not specify how those risks should be assessed, accepted, or mitigated.

anchor.note: p.36 l.Lines 415-420 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The text allows countries to proceed without national trust infrastructure while acknowledging the risks, but it does not specify how those risks should be assessed, accepted, or mitigated.
public.suggestedRevision: Require documented risk assessment, accountable risk acceptance, compensating controls, time-limited exceptions, monitoring, and a roadmap toward stronger assurance.
